description: This Java source file defines the class ShowActivity, which extends Activity. It is responsible for displaying details about a specific activity component, including its icon, label, process, task affinity, permissions, launch mode, and various flags. It retrieves the activity information from the Intent's data and populates the UI elements accordingly.

classes.name: ShowActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays detailed information about another activity component including its icon, label, process, and other attributes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves activity info based on Intent data, and populates UI elements with activity attributes.
